original: kiṃ bahunā, yā samantabhadrā prajñāpāramitā sā'bhāvarūpā ākāśalakṣaṇatvena śūnyatākārā viviktā prakṛtiprabhāsvarā jñānajñeyarahitā niḥsvabhāvalakṣaṇā dharmakāyapariṇatā satī vaineyajanaṃ prati sambhogakāyena sā vyavasthitā satī nirmāṇādikaṃ pratibhāsate(sayati) | sambhogakāyaś cāpi śūnyatālakṣaṇaṃ(ḥ) |
analyzed: kim bahunā yā samantabhadrā prajñāpāramitā sa abhāva rūpā ākāśa lakṣaṇa tvena śūnyatā ākārā viviktā prakṛti prabhāsvarā jñāna jñeya rahitā niḥsvabhāva lakṣaṇā dharmakāya pariṇatā satī vaineya janam prati sambhoga kāyena sā vyavasthitā satī nirmāṇa ādikam sambhoga kāyaḥ ca api śūnyatā lakṣaṇaḥ

original: śūnyatā ca sarvākāravaropetatvena vyavasthitā | māyāmarīcisvapnapratibimbapratiśrutyo(tko)dakacandranirmitopamasvabhāvatayā pratipadyata iti | tathā coktam— ``kāyaṃ sāmbhogikaṃ śūnyaṃ dharmakāyaṃ nairmāṇikaṃ kṛtvā bhāṣitaṃ sarvabuddhaiḥ'' [iti] |
analyzed: śūnyatā ca sarva ākāra vara upeta tvena vyavasthitā māyā marīci svapna pratibimba pratiśrutya utkodaka candra nirmita upama svabhāva tayā pratipadyate iti tathā ca uktam kāyam sāmbhogikam śūnyam dharmakāyam nairmāṇikam kṛtvā bhāṣitam sarva buddhaiḥ iti

original: prajñopāyaśabdena kim ucyate? prajñayā upāyaḥ prajñopāya iti, prajñājanita upāya ity arthaḥ | upāya ity anena śabdena ko 'rtho bhaṇyate? śrīvajrasattvaḥ saṃsārabhūtaḥ karuṇāsvabhāvaḥ sthiravastusvabhāvamūrtiḥ upāyaśabdenokta iti | upāyaḥ śrīvajrasattva iti | pañcakāyātmakaṃ pañcatathāgatātmakaṃ ca sphāraṇasaṃharaṇasvabhāvena vyavasthitam iti |
analyzed: prajñā upāya śabdena kim ucyate prajñayā upāyaḥ prajñā upāyaḥ iti prajñā janitaḥ upāyaḥ iti arthaḥ upāyaḥ iti anena śabdena kaḥ rthaḥ bhaṇyate śrī vajra sattvaḥ saṃsāra bhūtaḥ karuṇā svabhāvaḥ sthira vastu svabhāva mūrtiḥ upāya śabdena uktaḥ iti upāyaḥ śrī vajra sattvaḥ iti pañca kāya ātmakam pañca tathāgata ātmakam ca sphāraṇa saṃharaṇa svabhāvena vyavasthitam iti

original: vajrapadmasamāyogena
analyzed: vajra padma samāyogena

original: prajñāliṅgita ekākārarūpeṇa jñānasvabhāvaṃ bhāvayed iti | prajñopāya ity anayor dvayoḥ kaḥ sambandhaḥ? locanādipañcadevatyo bhūtādisvabhāvena śūnyatākārarūpeṇa pariṇatā iti | upāyo 'pi śrīvajrasattvaḥ sarvabhāvasvabhāvaḥ sthiracalasarvabhāvasvabhāvasya yā śūnyatā sā śūnyatākārayogena pariṇatā iti | oṃ hūṃ ity anenākṣaradvayena ekākāram iti |
analyzed: prajñā liṅgitaḥ eka ākāra rūpeṇa jñāna svabhāvam bhāvayet iti prajñā upāyaḥ iti anayoḥ dvayoḥ kaḥ sambandhaḥ locana ādi pañca devatyaḥ bhūta ādi svabhāvena śūnyatā ākāra rūpeṇa pariṇatāḥ iti śrī vajra sattvaḥ sarva bhāva svabhāvaḥ sthira cala sarva bhāva svabhāvasya yā śūnyatā sā śūnyatā ākāra yogena pariṇatāḥ iti om hūm iti anena akṣara dvayena eka ākāram iti

original: prajñopāyasthāpanārthaṃ dvidhārūpaṃ gataḥ | na ca vajrasattvo dvidhābhāvaṃ yāti | ta(ya)dā śūnyena śūnyatayā''krāntaṃ bhavati, tadā ekākāraṃ pratibhāsata iti | anyac ca prajñopāyātmakāḥ sarvasattvā iti ye prajñopāyasvabhāvadvaidhībhāvaṃ kurvanti tebhyo vidyāgrahagṛhītāḥ sambhoga(gaṃ) salīlam avalokya pārapatitās tiṣṭhanti |
analyzed: prajñā upāya sthāpana artham dvidhā rūpam gataḥ na ca vajra sattvaḥ dvidhā bhāvam yāti śūnyena śūnyatayā ākrāntam bhavati tadā eka ākāram pratibhāsate iti anyat ca prajñā upāya ātmakāḥ sarva sattvāḥ iti ye prajñā upāya svabhāva dvaidhībhāvam kurvanti tebhyaḥ vidyā graha gṛhītāḥ sambhoga gam sa līlam avalokya pāra patitāḥ tiṣṭhanti

original: ye punar advayākāraṃ viśuddhākāratayā tattvarūpaṃ paśyanti bhāvayanti ca, te 'nuttarabodhiphalalābhina iti | tena prajñopāyobhayasvabhāvatayā na kaścid buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ bandhanam | kaścit paṇḍitaḥ samatāyogena muktir bha(kto bha)vati | tathā coktam—
analyzed: ye punar advaya ākāram viśuddha ākāra tayā tattva rūpam paśyanti bhāvayanti ca te nuttara bodhi phala lābhinaḥ iti tena prajñā upāya ubhaya svabhāva tayā na kaścid buddhānām bhagavatām bandhanam kaścid paṇḍitaḥ samatā yogena muktiḥ bhaktaḥ bhavati tathā ca uktam

original: bajjhanti jeṇa jatā(ḍā) parimuṃcanti teṇa budhā |
analyzed: bajjhanti jeṇa jatāḍā parimuṃcanti teṇa budhā

original: bodhibibhāvanayā viparītam idaṃ sakalam ||
analyzed: bodhi bibhāvanayā viparītam idam sakalam

original: punaś coktam—
analyzed: punar ca uktam

original: yena yena hi bhāvena tatra tatrābhyāsabalād viśiṣṭatarasvabhāvam āviṣkaroty apunardṛṣṭadharmatālakṣaṇam | tathā coktam—
analyzed: yena yena hi bhāvena tatra tatra abhyāsa balāt viśiṣṭatara svabhāvam āviṣkaroti a punar dṛṣṭa dharma tā lakṣaṇam tathā ca uktam

original: yena yena hi bhāvena manaḥ saṃyujyate nṛṇām |
analyzed: yena yena hi bhāvena manaḥ saṃyujyate nṛṇām

original: tena tanmayatāṃ yāti viśvarūpo maṇir yathā ||
analyzed: tena tad maya tām yāti viśva rūpaḥ maṇiḥ yathā

original: punaś coktam—
analyzed: punar ca uktam

analyzed: yena yena hi badhyante jantavaḥ raudra karmaṇā

analyzed: sa upāyena tu tena eva mucyante bhava bandhanāt

analyzed: kāma śoka bhaya unmāda caura svapna ādi upaplutāḥ

analyzed: abhūtān api paśyanti puratas vasthitān iva

analyzed: tasmāt bhūtam abhūtam vā yat yat eva iti bhāvyate

original: bhāvanābalaniṣpattau tasya sākalyadhīḥ phalam ||
analyzed: bhāvanā bala niṣpattau tasya sākalya dhīḥ phalam

original: karuṇa uṇe viṇumuṇḍuhiṃ laggo | ṇaü so pāvaï uttima maggo ||
analyzed: karuṇaḥ uṇe viṇu muṇḍuhim laggo ṇañ saḥ maggo

analyzed: ahavā karuṇā kevali so saṃsāra mokṣa na

analyzed: yo puṇa viyoga ṇa sakkaï

original: ayam arthaḥ— karuṇa iti | karuṇārahito yadi śūnyatāyāṃ lagati, tadāsau yogī uttamamārgaṃ na labhate, buddhatvamārgaṃ na labhata iti yāvat | athavā śūnyatārahito yadi karuṇākevalī bhāvyate, tadā saṃsārasya mukti na labhyate | yaḥ punar yogī bhāvadvayaṃ jñātvā prajñopāyarāśidvayaṃ yojayituṃ śakyate, ekākāraṃ kartuṃ śakyate |
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ karuṇaḥ iti karuṇā rahitaḥ yadi śūnyatāyām lagati tadā asau yogī uttama mārgam na labhate buddhatva mārgam na labhate iti yāvat athavā śūnyatā rahitaḥ yadi karuṇā kevalī bhāvyate tadā saṃsārasya na labhyate yaḥ punar yogī bhāva dvayam jñātvā prajñā upāya rāśi dvayam yojayitum śakyate eka ākāram kartum śakyate

original: na tadbhavaṃ na nirvāṇam iti bhavaṃ saṃsāraṃ nirvāṇaṃ buddhatvam iti |
analyzed: na tad bhavam na nirvāṇam iti bhavam saṃsāram nirvāṇam buddhatvam iti

analyzed: ekāra ākṛti yat divyam madhye vaṃkāra bhūṣitam

analyzed: ālayaḥ sarva buddhānām buddha ratna karaṇḍakam

kṛtir iyam ācāryapadmavajrapādānām ||
